description.text: The other third expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released together with To Have Seen the Battle Rainbow on 16 June 2017. Necrozma, a legendary Pokémon new to the card game, appears on its wrapper and as Necrozma-GX, and the mythical Marshadow, about to make its debut in the film I Choose You! that July, arrived in the card game early as Marshadow-GX. Golisopod-GX and Gardevoir-GX join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 51, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Guzma and Wicke, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Super Scoop Up, Rescue Stretcher and Fairy Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Burning Shadows in August 2017.
